### 0.1.8 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added a first-attack lesson with editable damage and a live preview.
* Added searchable entity, item visual, and group pickers for projectile actions.
* Added projectile spawn offsets, saved position IDs, and explicit yaw and pitch controls to the Mob Editor.
##### Fixed
* Fixed inspector fields drawing outside their panel when a flyout was open.
##### Improved
* Improved BattleWorks flyout sizing and grouped technique actions beside the pattern list.
* Improved projectile picker opening and scrolling by loading creative categories on demand and reusing entity search results.

Global

Added

Fixed

Improved

  • Improved projectile picker opening and scrolling by loading creative categories on demand and reusing entity search results.
